question.en: When was the last time this country hosted the Olympic Games?
question.zh: 这个国家上次举办奥运会是什么时候？

sentences.en: When was the last time this country hosted the Olympic Games?
sentences.zh: 这个国家上次举办奥运会是什么时候？

sentences.en: The Olympic Games will be held in our country in four years' time.
sentences.zh: 四年以后，奥林匹克运动会将在我们国家举行。

sentences.en: As a great many people will be visiting the country, the government will be building new hotels, an immense stadium, and a new Olympic-standard swimming pool.
sentences.zh: 由于将有大批的人到我们国家来，政府准备建造新的饭店、一个大型体育场和一个新的奥运会标准游泳池。

chunks.x: As a great many people will be visiting the country

sentences.en: They will also be building new roads and a special railway line.
sentences.zh: 他们还将修建新的公路和一条铁路专线。

sentences.en: The Games will be held just outside the capital and the whole area will be called 'Olympic City'.
sentences.zh: 奥运会将在首都城外举行，整个地区将被称作“奥林匹克城”。

sentences.en: Workers will have completed the new roads by the end of this year.
sentences.zh: 工人们将在今年年底前把新路铺好。

chunks.x: by the end of this year

sentences.en: By the end of next year, they will have finished work on the new stadium.
sentences.zh: 到明年年底，他们将把新体育场建成。

chunks.x: By the end of next year

sentences.en: The fantastic modern buildings have been designed by Kurt Gunter.
sentences.zh: 这些奇妙的现代建筑是库尔特·冈特设计的。

sentences.en: Everybody will be watching anxiously as the new buildings go up.
sentences.zh: 大家都将焦急地注视着新建筑的建成。

chunks.x: as the new buildings go up

sentences.en: We are all very excited and are looking forward to the Olympic Games because they have never been held before in this country.
sentences.zh: 我们都非常激动，盼望着奥运会的到来，因为在这个国家还从未举办过奥运会。
